# BestRestaurantDenver.com

> A guide to eating in Denver, Colorado. The restaurant directory is the MICHELIN Guide Colorado
> selection reorganised to be searchable. The brunch list is ordered by counting independent
> published recommendations. We do not rank restaurants by opinion and we do not sell placement.
> Published by Search Converts LLC. Edited by Zach Wennstedt, Denver, Colorado.

## Editorial policy

- The restaurant directory contains only restaurants recognised by the MICHELIN Guide Colorado.
- No payment, affiliate link or placement fee affects any list on this site.
- The brunch ordering is a count of independent editorial mentions; every entry names its sources.
- We do not publish hours, prices, ratings or reviews we cannot source. No aggregateRating anywhere.
- Sponsored units are labelled as sponsored and sit outside every list.
- No AI-generated reviews, no fabricated statistics, no placeholder text.

## Pages

- [Best Restaurants In Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/): A searchable directory of every Michelin-recognized restaurant in Denver — 31 entries across stars, Bib Gourmands and recommended, with street addresses, neighborhoods and cuisine, plus how the award tiers work and how to get a table.
- [Denver Restaurants By Neighborhood](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/denver-restaurants-by-neighborhood/): All 15 Denver neighborhoods with a Michelin-recognized restaurant, ranked by count, with in-depth profiles of RiNo, LoHi, LoDo, Union Station, Platt Park and Sunnyside, plus honest walking distances between them.
- [Best Brunch In Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/best-brunch-in-denver/): Denver brunch ordered by cross-source consensus — how many of Westword, 5280, Time Out and the MICHELIN Guide independently recommend each spot — plus green chile brunch, bottomless rules and how to get a table.
- [What To Eat In Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/what-to-eat-in-denver/): Colorado green chile and the Pueblo Mosco chile, Palisade peaches, Olathe Sweet Corn, Rocky Ford melon, Colorado lamb and bison, the history of Denver's oldest restaurant, and a month-by-month Colorado harvest calendar.

## Tools on this site

- Denver restaurant directory — 31 Michelin-recognized restaurants, searchable by name, neighborhood, cuisine and award level.
- Neighborhood ranking — 15 Denver neighborhoods ordered by number of recognized restaurants.
- Brunch consensus list — filterable by neighborhood and style, with per-entry source attribution.
- Colorado harvest calendar — month-by-month guide to what is in season in Colorado.

## Sources

- MICHELIN Guide Colorado, 2025 selection (announced 15 September 2025).
- 5280 magazine, Westword and Time Out Denver for brunch recommendations.
- Colorado Department of Agriculture and Colorado State University for produce and chile facts.
